messages:
maya: Quick check — can we tighten the oncall handoff from 20m to 10m for weekday shifts? Proposal: a focused 10m 'handoff huddle' + an async checklist in Notion. Trying to reduce meeting fatigue while keeping coverage. Thoughts?

noah: +1 to experiment. main concern: make sure escalation attendance rules are crystal clear (who must join if something is open). also timezone impact for APAC. :thinking_face:

liam: I'm fine with 10m for weekday day shifts. Night shifts probably need a slightly different flow. Happy to volunteer as escalation captain for Mon/Tue nights for the trial.

maya: thanks liam! Proposal idea for escalation attendance: if incident is active (open Sev1/2), mandatory: oncall + last responder + service owner (or their delegate). If >2hrs, page ops-lead. If >4hrs, escalate to eng manager. Thoughts?

sophia: that makes sense. Also suggest adding an explicit bit in the huddle for "blocking mitigations" so incoming oncall knows current throttles/circuit-breakers. And add a short line for "next 2 actions".

noah: agreed. Can we capture the 10m template as a tiny code snippet so it's always consistent?

maya: yep — draft template below (use as Notion checklist):

```
Handoff huddle (target: 10m)
- Active incidents (IDs + severity + owner)
- Current mitigations (what's in place now)
- Open actions (next 2 items with assignees)
- Escalation status (who is on escalation)
- Known regressions / recent deploys
- Any follow-ups for infra/team leads
```

rekha: From ops POV, add "est. MTTx" (rough expected time to mitigate) if known, and a quick note if the incident is trending up. Also okay to trial 10m for 2 weeks and then measure missed info.

engoncall-bot: NOTE: Trial period scheduled: 2026-04-05 -> 2026-04-18. Automated reminder will post 10min before each weekday handoff.

maya: thanks rekha & bot. For timezones: if APAC overlap is outside normal hours, we'll require async checklist + a 5min async summary thread in #eng-oncall with the same template fields (so incoming oncall can scan).

liam: quick scheduling question — who should be listed as "escalation captain" on calendar invites? We should rotate weekly and post the name in the handoff thread. I can take week of Apr 5.

noah: I'll update the /handoffs calendar and add a rotating slot called "Escalation Captain". Can everyone ACK availability for their weeks by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:

maya: ACK from me. Linking Notion template here: https://redwoodhq.notion.site/Oncall-Handoff-Template-abc123 (please don't share externally).

rekha: ops ACK. We'll enforce mandatory joins for open Sev1/2 and will monitor missing joins during trial.

liam: ACK — I'll put my availability in the shared doc.

sophia: ACK. One tiny ask — can the handoff thread include a short line noting any pending RFC/design reviews that could impact the current incident (helps oncall know if a rollback touches ongoing work)?

maya: good call. adding a "Potential RFC/design impact" line to the template.

noah: done — calendar and weekly rotation updated. First trial handoff on 2026-04-05 at 09:50 PT (10m). Reminder bot will ping.

maya: perfect. Let's run for two weeks and sync results in the 15-min retro on 2026-04-20. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
